errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer is requested but not found in the system by customer_id.

errors.name: PurchaseNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a purchase is requested but not found in the system by purchase_id.

errors.name: InvalidCustomerIdError
errors.description: Raised when a customer_id provided is not a valid integer or is otherwise malformed.

errors.name: MissingCustomerEmailError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to access a customer's email but the email field is missing from the customer record.

errors.name: MissingPurchaseAmountError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to access a purchase's amount but the amount field is missing from the purchase record.
